challengeTypes: identify: What does the SUN give us? (Light and heat vs Food and water vs Clothes and toys)
identify: Why does the MOON change shape? (We see different parts lit by the sun vs The moon is broken vs The moon disappears)

sort: Drag each sky object to its correct description (Sun: star that gives light and heat | Moon: satellite that reflects sunlight | Stars: far away suns that twinkle | Earth: our planet where we live)
identify: What are the physical features of a locality? (Mountains, rivers, plains, and ponds vs Only buildings and roads vs Only people and animals)

sort: Drag each physical feature to its correct type (Mountain: tall land form | River: flowing water body | Plain: flat land | Pond: small still water | Hill: smaller than mountain | Valley: low land between hills)
identify: Why do we need CLEAN water to drink? (Dirty water has germs that make us sick vs Dirty water tastes better vs Dirty water is cheaper)

sort: Drag each item to Clean/Healthy or Dirty/Unhealthy (Clean: filtered water, fresh food, covered food, trees for clean air | Dirty: open drain water, spoiled food, smoke from factory, uncovered food with flies)

sort: Drag each action to Keep Clean or Causes Pollution (Keep Clean: boil water before drinking, cover food, plant trees, use dustbin | Causes Pollution: throw waste in river, burn plastic, cut trees, leave food uncovered)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Earth, sun, moon and stars — sun is a star that gives light and heat. Moon is earth's satellite, reflects sunlight, changes shape (phases) because we see different lit parts. Stars are far-away suns, twinkle because of air movement. Earth is our planet, round like a ball, has land and water, supports life. Day and night: earth rotates, sun-facing side has day, other side has night. (2) Physical features of my locality — physical features are natural land and water forms: mountains (tall land), hills (smaller mountains), plains (flat land), valleys (low land between hills), rivers (flowing water), ponds (small still water), lakes (large still water), forests (dense trees). These are natural, not made by humans. (3) Need for clean food, air and water — clean food: fresh, covered, washed, not spoiled. Dirty food has germs and flies, causes stomach diseases. Clean air: no smoke, dust, or pollution. Dirty air causes coughing, asthma. Plant trees for clean air. Clean water: filtered or boiled, no germs. Dirty water causes cholera, diarrhoea. Keep water covered. Misconceptions: 'moon produces its own light' (moon reflects sunlight — it does not make light), 'stars are small' (stars are huge suns very far away — they look small because of distance), 'sun moves around earth' (earth moves around sun — day and night happen because earth rotates), 'physical features are buildings and roads' (physical features are NATURAL — mountains, rivers, plains — not human-made), 'all water is safe to drink' (only filtered/boiled water is safe — river and pond water has germs). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function EarthSkyGame), NOT export default. Export interface EarthSkyGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
